import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.text import Text
from rich.style import Style
from rich.screen import Screen

def test_double_width_char_in_modal_screen():
    console = Console(width=60, height=11)
    text = Text("青春サツバツ論", style=Style(bgcolor="surface"))
    screen = Screen(text, style=Style(bgcolor="surface"))
    result = console.render(screen)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert len(result[0]) == 60
